candidates.name: Babby Building Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Toilet Partitions is a product category on its site, and the site says customers can schedule an installation under warranty through Babby or buy materials directly. It lists Division 6, 9, 10, 11 and 12 work, including toilet accessories and partitions.
red_flags: Sells and supplies toilet partitions itself (buy-around risk)
No project photos of partition installs seen
candidates.reason: Tucson Division 10 specialty contractor whose own site offers toilet partition supply and warranty installation for commercial building types. It is a strong installer, but it is also a direct partition seller.

license.name: Babby Building Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: Arizona Registrar of Contractors (AZ ROC) Contractor Search, https://azroc.my.site.com/AZRoc/s/contractor-search
license.license_number: 334946 (self-reported on company site, not confirmed on the ROC record)
license.license_type: unknown (classification not read on the official record)
license.note: The AZ ROC contractor search is a Salesforce page that only loads with JavaScript. Automated fetches got only a 'Sorry to interrupt / CSS Error' shell, and the page's security policy loads reCAPTCHA, so the official record could not be read. The company homepage says 'AZ ROC License #334946', phone 520.624.8837, based in Tucson. Someone needs to check license 334946 by hand at the ROC search for status, classification (a commercial specialty class such as partitions or toilet accessories) and expiration. Levelset (third party, not a registry) lists the company as a Tucson specialties contractor: https://levelset.com/subcontractors/arizona/tucson/specialties/babby-building-specialties-inc. Tucson also requires a licensed contractor for commercial work. Whether a city business license is needed was not checked.

candidates.name: Partitions & Accessories Co.
candidates.review_source: BBB rating A+, accredited (no review count read)
candidates.partition_evidence: A search summary of its Blue Book profile (the page returned 403 when fetched) says it stocks toilet partitions, installs about four days after measuring, and lists Tucson Premium Outlets among its projects. The BBB lists it under Partitions.
red_flags: Based in Mesa, about 100 miles from Tucson
Install details came from a search snippet, not a page read directly
candidates.reason: An established Arizona partition supplier and installer that works statewide, Tucson included, but it is based in Mesa, well outside the 30-mile radius. Consider it as a fallback for Tucson jobs if local coverage is thin.

candidates.name: Inter-Co Division 10 (Arizona) Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its homepage says it supplies and installs Division 10 products, toilet partitions among them. No partition install project in Arizona was shown.
red_flags: Toronto-based supplier that sells partitions (buy-around risk)
candidates.reason: A Division 10 supplier and installer whose Arizona office is in Phoenix, outside the area. It is also a partition seller.
